Configuration and scheduling

Five worker processes each use three Rayon threads: 15 configured proving threads on an 18-core system. Each job aggregates eight existing inputs. Workers start after the preceding worker finishes initial preprocessing.

Apple Metal compact proving, CPU quotient evaluation, direct readback and GPU query gathering remain enabled. Each worker uses a 7 GiB managed allocation allowance, 2 GiB LDE transform scratch allowance and 1 GiB query scratch allowance. These allowances overlap; they are not preallocated VRAM or total process-memory limits.

Two heavy-stage permits, one late-stage permit and one query permit coordinate the processes. Public preprocessing is shared read-only. Private salt matrices become RNG checkpoints after GPU commitment; requested salts are replayed exactly. Memory controls and proof binaries match the previous four-worker result; worker count and CPU threads per worker changed.

Observed simultaneous stages: heavy 2, late 1, query 1. Maximum concurrent proofs after heavy-stage admission: 3. That count excludes workers waiting to enter that stage; five worker processes were requested.

The controller’s original 200/hour target was met. The separate 218.54/hour optimization threshold permits up to 10% loss from the earlier three-worker result: 40 equivalents must finish within 658.93 seconds including independent CPU audits. The threshold is an evaluation criterion, not a timeout. No total benchmark timeout or fixed worker RSS ceiling was used. Memory-pressure monitoring remained active.

This is one fresh five-worker sample. It does not establish statistical confidence or sustained capacity. Builds and fixture creation are outside the timing window; worker launches, launch staggering, proof generation, pruning, profiling overhead and independent CPU root audits are included. Previously passed correctness qualification was reused after proof-source and binary hashes were verified.

Cleanup verified: tracked benchmark processes exited and shared preprocessing scratch was removed. 198 proof-source hashes, copied binary hashes and the source archive hash matched after execution.
